verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an API reference exists, since the MCP server gives agents access to it, and a sandbox test environment. Nothing documents an interactive API reference with runnable examples, such as a try-it console or executable request samples. Public OpenAPI spec paths all returned 404, and sandbox testing docs and MCP access are adjacent capabilities, not an interactive runnable reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
